agent_notes: The supplied 2025 NIRF Agriculture and Overall pages both list the exact institution name with Jhansi, Uttar Pradesh.

Normal TLS verification first returned the managed proxy error 'self signed certificate in certificate chain'; public GET requests to the expected nirfindia.org and rlbcau.ac.in hosts were retried with curl --insecure. No credentials or private data were sent.

The official headquarters page confirms NH-75, near Pahuj Dam, Gwalior Road, Jhansi, Uttar Pradesh - 284003. The official college-address page also documents the Datia campus in Madhya Pradesh; courses are separated by campus.

The central official Academic Programmes page lists 3 UG and 8 PG programmes, while official College of Agriculture and College of Horticulture and Forestry pages state additional PG and doctoral offerings. The official PG admission and enquiry pages state that their content is under updation, and the official College of Fisheries page does not state degree programme names. The catalogue is therefore partial/conflicting and requires manual review.

The Main Campus certificate listing is explicitly for session 2025-26, while the Datia Campus listing is for session 2026-27. They are retained as official certificate-catalogue entries, but the current activation/freshness of the Jhansi short certificates should be rechecked.

Official agriculture pages use variant labels such as Plant Breeding & Genetics versus Genetics & Plant Breeding and Soil Science & Agricultural Chemistry versus Soil Science; no unsupported additional specialization was invented.

The official veterinary college page confirms B.V.Sc. and A.H., M.V.Sc., and Ph.D. degree families but does not enumerate all M.V.Sc. or Ph.D. disciplines; only the verified programme families are included. No news-only programme titles were imported.

The career tree has no dedicated horticulture, forestry, fisheries, dairy, animal-production, or GIS nodes. Those courses were mapped to the closest responsible agriculture or veterinary parent with medium or low confidence and an explicit nearest-parent relation.
